deadline.value: Applications completed before January 15 get full consideration for teaching assistantships.
deadline.quote: Applications to the doctoral program completed before January 15 will receive full consideration for TA positions.

gre_subject.value: The math department says the Subject GRE is not required.

supervisor.value: The department page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are mainly supported by teaching assistantships and are normally funded for at least five years.
funding.quote: Full-time PhD students in mathematics are supported primarily through teaching assistantship (TA) positions. | normally funded for at least five (and sometimes six) years

entry_route.value: The department page does not say whether a master's is needed.

toefl_min.value: Columbian College minimum is TOEFL 4 (new scale); 5 (new scale) avoids the required first-semester English course.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum requirement, requires EAP course 81 (old test) 4 (new test)

ielts_min.quote: Minimum requirement, requires EAP course 81 (old test) 4 (new test) 6.0 (with no individual band score below 5.0)

notes: The department says it will have fully funded positions for the Fall 2027 cycle.
